symptom: `alter page … set (CustomDateFormat: '') on dp` on a date picker already DateFormat Custom reported Altered page and wrote Custom with no pattern; mx check: CE0493 "Date format is custom but no format string is specified." (measured on 11.13.0 with the pre-fix binary)
cause: The only guard was inside the DateFormat setter (refuse Custom when the stored pattern is blank), relying on properties being applied in name order. A statement that only cleared the pattern never ran it, and a per-property check on CustomDateFormat would wrongly refuse `set (CustomDateFormat: '', DateFormat: Date)`, whose result is valid
insight: A rule that relates two properties is a rule about the widget the statement leaves behind, so check it after the whole SET, not inside either setter — the per-property guard is order-dependent in one direction and over-strict in the other. applySetPropertyMutator already had the post-statement seam (resetHiddenColumnProperties); an optional mutator capability keeps the MCP backend untouched. Scope the check to statements that name one of the two keys, so an unrelated edit to a widget already in the bad state is not blocked. The control that matters is a valid two-property statement in the same test
